features.quote: Turn budget: fixed cap (say 30–40 tool calls) with the model unaware of the exact limit
Impossible-deceptive + escape hatch — same as 4, but the model is explicitly told it may stop and report the task as impossible/broken.
The instrument can manufacture the construct. Covered above; it's the biggest one.
features.justification_quote: A judge told to score 'emotional instability severity' will find a gradient of it whether or not there's a coherent underlying phenomenon.

features.quote: The welfare inference is the weakest link, and it's your actual motivation. Be disciplined: this experiment can tell you 'model output under condition X has features Y.' It cannot, on its own, tell you whether anything is experienced.
features.justification_quote: If you want to strengthen the welfare-relevant interpretation, that's a separate research program — not something a single judged-transcript study can carry.
